decision.user_intent: A+B memory: continuous Witness plus compact significant memory. Nodes commonly use local flash/SD; nodes without storage forward state to a storage-capable swarm peer. Old ordinary data may be removed only after useful information is extracted, while anomalies, unusual cases and forensic-significant episodes are preserved.

memory_tiers.L0_live_ring: bounded RAM ring for recent high-resolution context and anomaly pre/post windows
memory_tiers.L1_local_witness: continuous append-oriented sensor/swarm/prediction/model history while capacity allows
memory_tiers.L2_semantic_episode_memory: compact durable memory of anomalies, rare events, major prediction errors, regime changes, failures/recoveries, model breakthroughs/regressions and pinned episodes
memory_tiers.L3_swarm_archive: trusted storage-capable peer/NAS/Habitat archive with source/session/schema/time-range/integrity metadata

storage_capability_rule.node_with_storage: store locally first, then compact/archive according to budget
storage_capability_rule.node_without_storage: buffer short-term and forward state/episodes to a storage-capable peer
storage_capability_rule.network_absent: continue within local bounded capacity and mark archival debt
storage_capability_rule.reconnect: repay archival debt and require durable receipt acknowledgement

conditions: no unresolved anomaly depends on the window
no model regression/debug investigation requires it
required remote archive has acknowledged durable receipt where applicable

decision.test_gate: Power-cycle persistence + ring rollover + SD-full behavior + no-storage offload + receipt ACK + reconnect debt repayment + anomaly pinning + auditable compaction/deletion
